source_file: 10171744_2021_Sam Sohn v. California Housing Financing Agency_cand
reasoning: Pro se complaint challenging mortgage relief program administration; the court found no factual allegations tying any adverse housing action to a protected class under the FHA, leaving the grievance unconnected to any cognizable FHA cause of action.

The court dismissed on threshold jurisdictional grounds (including Rooker-Feldman / standing-type defects) without reaching FHA merits.
Complaint concerning hotel stay did not plead facts fitting any FHA cause of action because a transient hotel is not a 'dwelling' and no cognizable FHA theory was identified.
